teardown_timeline: The probe initializes aw8693x_func_list and reaches aw8693x_creat_node through slot 1; vibrator_init has already registered the LED child and created vibrator_attribute_group on that child's kobject.

The generic group exposes ram_update_store and activate_aw_store; the second AW group exposes rtp_auto_sin_store. Target device creation stores led_cdev as the child's drvdata, allowing these callbacks to derive the owning state.
aw_remove cancels state+0x3a0 and state+0x428, then continues resource teardown while both LED child groups remain registered.
The parent driver core invokes devres_release_all only after aw_remove returns. The managed LED release then unregisters the LED child and removes its sysfs groups.

A store during the remove window can therefore resubmit either canceled work item or submit ram_load asynchronously with raw state context. The sysfs callback returning does not drain the driver workqueue or the separate firmware callback.

finding.title: managed LED sysfs groups remain active through aw_remove
finding.condition: normal probe reaches the relevant sysfs_create_group call and a store runs after aw_remove begins but before the managed LED devres release

affected_submissions.effect: can queue state+0x428 after aw_remove canceled that work item
can queue state+0x3a0 after aw_remove canceled that work item
can submit ram_load through request_firmware_nowait with raw state context
affected_submissions.condition: input parses successfully and is nonzero

finding.impact: work may run after its remove-time cancellation and access state or chip operations during teardown; the firmware callback can outlive remove and access devm state after release

limits: The path is conditional on successful sysfs group creation and a userspace store during the remove window.

Stock reachability and ordering are statically established from raw module relocations, stock AArch64 assembly, and the pinned target-kernel source; no scheduler or hardware reproduction was performed.
This identifies additional producers for existing lifetime endpoints and is tracked as a sysfs exposure finding rather than a claim of a new firmware-loader defect.
No reconstruction source changed and no Docker rebuild was run.
hardening_follow_up: In a separately identified hardening candidate, set a dying/admission gate before teardown so no sysfs store or LED callback can submit new work.
Unregister the managed LED child while state remains valid; then drain any sysfs store already in flight and all work items it may have submitted.
Track and drain asynchronous firmware callbacks before releasing the state allocation.
Only after every producer is quiesced, cancel state+0x3a0 and state+0x428 and destroy state+0x448 before freeing the owning state.
